ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Wildsteam Egg Bounty
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WEBWORK_NEST_EGG_ECONOMY_1, S6 ruling 2 (owner, question card, 2026-09-24): "the Wildsteam pay an egg BOUNTY — they pay to destroy eggs, the same shape as the mandible bounty. A second, lower-paying legal outlet beside the smugglers' jackpot." Per the follow-up 2026-09-24 sitting (webwork_egg_blackmarket_2026-09-24.md §1e/§1f): the Wildsteam route pays market value x0.5-0.7 as goodwill-plus-silver, deliberately below the black market's premium — "virtue pays less."
Ships one QuestScriptDef (RUT_WildsteamEggBounty), built on the exact same vanilla QuestNode_TradeRequest_Initiate/TradeRequestComp machinery Core's own TradeRequest quest and this repo's own RUT_FungalSoilTradeRequest already use (see that quest's own header for the pattern this one copies) — the Wildsteam "buy" the delivered eggs at a below-market price and the fiction is that they destroy them; mechanically this is an ordinary settlement trade request, the same as every other one in the campaign.
THE ONE DEPARTURE FROM THAT PATTERN: vanilla's own QuestNode_GetNearbySettlement has no faction-filter field (the same open question RUT_FungalSoilTradeRequest.xml already flags for its own Moisture Farmer case) — this quest is specifically the Wildsteam Clan's own bounty, not a random nearby settlement's, so a small custom QuestNode (RM_QuestNode_GetWildsteamSettlement.cs) finds the nearest live settlement belonging specifically to RUT_Jawa_WildsteamClan via Find.FactionManager.FirstFactionOfDef (verified live in this repo, src/RimUtinni/PyrelandsMechanics/Source/PyrelandsFactions.cs) and Find.WorldObjects.SettlementBases, standard RimWorld.Planet API.
Depends on mandrake.rm.webwork (RM_OllathrixEgg, the requested item) and mandrake.rut.patches (RUT_Jawa_WildsteamClan, the FactionDef this quest is scoped to).
NOT built here (WEBWORK_EGG_BLACKMARKET_BUILD_1's own scope, S5 rulings, a separate sitting): the Cartel black-market trader/caravan kind, the Bazaar broker channel, the tradeability-All patch, and The Reckoning assassination quest family. Those consume the same RM_OllathrixEgg item this mod's quest also prices against, but neither item's build touches the other's files.
